notes.title: DREDGE is out now on Mac for Steam!
notes.content:
Hey Anglers,

[b]We've just released DREDGE on macOS for Steam! [/b]We hope Mac players enjoy the start of their adventures in our mysterious archipelago of Greater Marrow... and beyond! 🌏

Captain your fishing trawler to explore a collection of remote isles, and their surrounding depths, to see what lies below. Sell your catch to the locals and complete quests to learn more about each area’s troubled past. Outfit your boat with better equipment to trawl deep-sea trenches and navigate to far-off lands, but keep an eye on the time. You might not like what finds you in the dark...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40894993/9fd2ac5653b3b0b5d6a6a413125ab8b8146cd6ea.png[/img]

[h3]DREDGE - Key Features:[/h3]

[b]❓ Unravel a Mystery:[/b] Captain your fishing trawler across a collection of remote islands, each with its own inhabitants to meet, wildlife to discover, and stories to unearth

[b]⛵ DREDGE the Depths:[/b] Scour the sea for hidden treasures and complete quests to gain access to strange new abilities

[b]🎣 Study Your Craft:[/b] Research special equipment and upgrade your boat’s capabilities to gain access to rare fish and valuable deep-sea curios 

[b]🐠 Fish to Survive:[/b] Sell your discoveries to the locals to learn more about each area, and upgrade your boat to reach even more secluded locations 

[b]👁️ Fight the Unfathomable[/b]: Strengthen your mind and use your abilities to survive trips out on the water after dark.

[b]Learn more about DREDGE on our Steam page: ⬇️[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1562430/DREDGE/

[h2]DREDGE Expansions[/h2]
Alongside the base game, DREDGE Expansions are also available for Mac on Steam, which includes The Iron Rig and The Pale Reach Expansions! Learn more about both expansions below:

[h3]The Iron Rig[/h3]
Uncover ancient disturbances and craft advanced equipment, items and gadgets with the help of new acquaintances. Join Ironhaven Corp's efforts to assemble The Iron Rig, but be wary. What are they truly here for?

[b]The Iron Rig: Key Features[/b]
[list][*] 2-5 hours of content playable at any time in your playthrough
[*] Craft a new tier of equipment with 8 new pieces of gear
[*] Catch more than 50 new fish
[*] Advance to a new tier of boat hull, bigger and better than before
[*] Research enhanced versions of some abilities
[*] Earn 12 achievements[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2561450/DREDGE__The_Iron_Rig/

[h3]The Pale Reach[/h3]
Explore the treacherous ice fields to discover a mystery frozen under the ice. You'll retrace the steps of the last crew that came before you and unearth a story of bitter betrayal. Find some familiar faces and develop new equipment to navigate the area and profit from its inhabitants.

[b]The Pale Reach: Key Features[/b]
[list][*] 1-3 hours of content playable at any time in your playthrough
[*] Discover 3 new pieces of equipment to catch 11 new fish and crab species
[*] Craft a new boat add-on to smash through the ice
[*] Purchase ice blocks to extend the shelf-life of your most valuable catches
[*] 8 achievements[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2561440/DREDGE__The_Pale_Reach/

notes.title: No Man’s Sky's Aquarius update brings a touch of Dredge to the cosmos by letting you become an interstellar fisherperson
notes.content:
If you enjoy standing by virtual bodies of water and praying that you've picked the right worm to tempt what dwells within to take a little nibble, the latest update for No Man's Sky is definitely for you. Dubbed Aquarius, it arrives today, September 4, and is all about reeling in alien fish via a bunch of new mechanics.

Following on from the pretty popular Worlds Update part one - which revamped planet biomes with stuff like fresh weather effects and more immersive water - Hello Games has been inspired by a bit of Reddit fan art to give folks the chance to embrace their inner angler.

As outlined in the patch notes and the trailer below, Aquarius adds fishing to the game via new systems that'll let players "explore the universe to find their perfect waterside spot, hopping with fish - sit and relax alone with their thoughts, or with fellow Travelers looking out over alien vistas waiting for a bite."

Read more

notes.title: DREDGE Hotfix v1.5.2
notes.content:
Hey Anglers,

We've just released update 1.5.2 for DREDGE. 

This update fixes a handful of bugs and improves a few areas that have been catching players out since our release of The Iron Rig the other week.

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[h3]Adjustments[/h3][list]
[*] Exotic bait no longer requires the correct rod to be equipped in order for it to be placed. You'll still need the correct rod to catch whatever shows up though!

[*] Added a map marker for the rig's location before you visit it.
[*] Added 1-2 nautiloids to each of their spawn locations.
[/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed an item duplication bug.
[*] The portal from the Aurous Anchor now visually layers better when placed on ooze.
[*] The Leviathan will no longer be able to consume players as they're in the process of docking at the rig.
[*] Fixed an issue where one patch of ooze couldn't be fully cleared in Twisted Strand under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could mark bait spots on their map, causing a number of flow-on issues with the map and spyglass.
[*] A handful of small text fixes.
[/list]

Additionally, the whole team is incredibly grateful for your support. The reception to The Iron Rig has exceeded our expectations, and we're so happy you've enjoyed diving back into the world of DREDGE.

<3 Black Salt Games

notes.title: DREDGE: The Iron Rig - Available Now!
notes.content:
Hey Anglers,

We’ve just released update 1.5.1 for DREDGE. The majority of this update is focused on the addition of our new DLC, The Iron Rig, but it also contains fixes and tweaks for all players! Check out the brand new trailer for the DLC below, then read on for the (spoiler-free) patch notes.

[previewyoutube=-vKAZdpzDf8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[h2]For owners of The Iron Rig:[/h2]
[h3]Features[/h3]
The Iron Rig paid DLC - a new constructable destination visitable at any time in your playthrough, with new:[list][*] Fish[*] Pursuits [*]Equipment[*] Achievements [*] Enhanced Abilities[*]Consumable items[*] ...and more![/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2561450/DREDGE__The_Iron_Rig/
[h2]For all players:[/h2]
[h3]Features[/h3][list]
[*]Added some new apparitions that can rarely be seen through the fog.
[*]Added the ability to select which Crab Pot & Bait type is being deployed.
[*]Added a custom background when using a late-game ability to harvest fish.
[*]Added a custom background to most shore caches.
[*]Added a new shipwreck to Stellar Basin
[*]Added Polish language.
[*]Added new themes for the title screen. These are unlocked by owning their respective DLC, and can be selected via a new setting in the “General” section.
[list][*]The "Complete Edition" theme requires The Pale Reach, The Iron Rig, and Blackstone Key DLCs.[/list][/list][h3]Adjustments[/h3][list]
[*]Increased the size of Storage from 72 to 99 cells.
[*]Increased the maximum number of map markers from 50 to 100.
[*]Reduced maximum panic-reducing effect of lights by 10%
[*]Made the Game Over screen look nicer.
[*]Moved a small number of fishing and dredging spots around.
[*]Added a paint bucket icon to The Painter in Little Marrow.
[*]Infection can now spread even if your inventory is open.
[list][*]Infection can now [REDACTED][/list][*]When new abilities are unlocked, they’re now highlighted on the radial ability wheel until selected.
[*]Your Net tab can now be viewed at some additional locations to facilitate [REDACTED].
[*]Added new names to the credits.
[*]The UI now completely disappears during cutscenes in The Iron Rig and The Pale Reach.
[*]Changing the language now changes which primary font is used.
[list][*]Added a new Russian font[/list][*]Numerous performance tweaks and optimizations.
[/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list]
[*]Fixed a longstanding issue/exploit where saving and reloading caused all fishing and dredging spots to repopulate. Sorry!
[*]Fixed a longstanding issue where research parts never appeared in crab pots. You're welcome!
[*]Fixed an issue where, in extremely rare cases, if a save file failed to load, the game would overwrite it with a new save.
[*]When a [REDACTED] causes a fish to land on your deck, it now counts towards your catch count in the encyclopedia, and will show the "new species" banner if it's a new discovery.
[*]Adjusted the position of the panic tutorial slightly to not overlap the panic eye animation so much.
[*]Trawl nets no longer function during the final cutscene, which prevents "new species discovered!" banners from popping up over the climax of the game.
[*]Ravens will no longer spawn if the player is currently right next to a dock.
[*]Random events will no longer spawn while the player is locked in dialogue with the photographer in The Pale Reach.
[*]The light on the Fort in Stellar Basin is now visible from further away.
[*]The "Perfect Packing" achievement wasn't unlocking in some scenarios.
[*]The "debt repayment" bar at Greater Marrow wasn't respecting custom colour choices.
[*]Placing map markers should always play a SFX now.
[*]The creaking traps in Twisted Strand are no longer audible from halfway across the map.
[*]Fixed an issue where text could get stuck on screen if it was very short, and Text Speed was set to Fast. Mostly affected Korean and Chinese languages.
[*]When playing with a cursor, you can no longer click on the Cargo tab while using the Spyglass.
[*]Quest grids that require players to make a decision about whether to pick up or leave an item no longer show a (non-functional) "Return to town" prompt.
[*]Players can no longer pick up an item from some quest grids and then interact with dialogs with the item still on their cursor.
[*]Removed a couple of bushes that were floating in the sky above Twisted Strand. Apologies to the folks who thought this was us hinting at a secret zone in the clouds!
[*]Adjusted a few pieces of terrain to prevent the hull of your boat from clipping through.
[*]The Travelling Merchant's bunting has been re-added.
[*]Rain no longer looks weird when climbing the steps to the Ancient Lighthouse.
[*]The Photographer's camera case is no longer able to be discarded via the temporary storage tray beneath the fishing minigame.
[*]Hundreds of text and localization fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Nominate DREDGE for Outstanding Visual Style - Steam Awards 2023
notes.content:
Alex will hate that we're doing this, but dang if the rest of us don't want this for him! We are unashamedly asking you to nominate DREDGE for Best Visuals in this year’s Steam Awards. This is why we think our amazing art director Alex Ritchie deserves such incredible recognition. 

Being a team of only four people and with only a small budget, Alex has spent three years of his life compromising his ideal vision while still creating a visual world of incredible tone and depth. He's been able to mix 2D illustrations in a 3D world and make it feel right in this cosmic horror setting, not to mention has conjured up some pretty disturbing aberrant fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40894993/d2f1f41b6b16964b6d7f0eda805d415bc98a9d72.jpg[/img]

If you enjoyed your time in DREDGE and were able to immerse yourself in this lonely, forlorn world, please nominate us for [b]Outstanding Visual Style[/b] in this year's Steam Awards and make Alex blush!

- Joel, Alex, Nadia & Mikey

notes.title: Nominate DREDGE for Game of the Year - Steam Awards 2023
notes.content:
It's the big one, and it feels a bit ridiculous to campaign for it but we keep being surprised at the astounding volume of support we receive so, let's go for it!

It's not an easy sell with so many incredible games released this year across the whole gamut of studios; tiny debut indies and triple-A's alike, but here's why we would love you to consider us alongside the other games you've enjoyed playing this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40894993/7459fccc25b363b02bbc9d71ea65df4db89389e6.png[/img]

This game was crafted with players experience, enjoyment and comfort first and foremost. We knew we couldn't make a really long game with DREDGE without introducing artificial grinds, and we didn't want to do that, so hours were spent with our incredible playtesters making sure there was never a point where you didn't have anything to do, or felt you were being held back.

We also didn't know how many people might pick up DREDGE but we wanted every single one of them to enjoy their time if possible. We're really proud not just of the accessibility options we were able to implement, but in the core design itself allow players to choose how much of the spookier side of things they interacted with, by giving them agency over whether they ventured out at night or not.

If you have appreciated your time in DREDGE and think it's a game that many people could enjoy, please vote for us for [b]Game of the Year[/b] in the 2023 Steam Awards.

- Joel, Alex, Nadia & Mikey

notes.title: Nominate DREDGE for Best Soundtrack - Steam Awards 2023
notes.content:
DREDGE is a game of contrasts, and our incredible composer David Mason elevated this to new levels in the audio design of DREDGE. The subtle use of soft instrumental stingers during the day and a sinister soundscape at night is intended to help amplify the feelings of loneliness and claustrophobia we wanted the open waters to evoke. Each area has its own distinct set of instruments, and each dock has its own theme within the world. For a quick refresher, check out the free version of our soundtrack:

[previewyoutube=rr94J_GjpCM;full][/previewyoutube]
We are so happy David decided to send us an e-mail completely out of the blue one day to see if we needed a composer for DREDGE, and that he was still keen a few months later when we realised we really did! We are all so proud of the combination of his music and our game world.

Please help us show our appreciation by nominating DREDGE for[b] Best Soundtrack[/b] in this year’s Steam Awards.

- Joel, Alex, Nadia & Mikey

notes.title: Nominate DREDGE for the 2023 Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Hey Anglers,

The 2023 Steam Awards are here! Steam is inviting players to nominate their favourite game within a specific award category. If you’ve enjoyed DREDGE this year, then we’d love it if you could nominate us in the [b]‘Best Game on Steam Deck’[/b] category.

However, if you’d like to nominate us for a different category, then we think the following categories, in the following order, suit DREDGE best:

[list]
[*] Best Game on Steam Deck
[*] Best Soundtrack 
[*] Game of the Year 
[*] Outstanding Visual Style
[/list]
Whether it's DREDGE or another game, your nomination counts for a lot. There have been a lot of great games released this year, so make sure you consider them for a nomination too if you don't nominate DREDGE. 

[h3]Why should you vote for DREDGE for [b]‘Best Game on Steam Deck’[/b]?[/h3]

There's nothing like the feeling of seeing hard work paying off and that is definitely the case with our portable controls! We spent countless hours with our wonderful playtesters trying to create what felt the most intuitive and comfortable for long play sessions, and we have to thank them for their patience and honest feedback, helping us get the positive responses we did.

Players tell us DREDGE is the perfect game for a long flight or a commute, if you feel the same please nominate DREDGE for Best Game on Steam Deck at this year's Steam Awards. 

[i]“Dredge continues to run extremely well right out of the box, making it one of our Best on Deck games!”[/i] - [b]Steam Deck HQ[/b]

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FmS68hxaMAAWBbR?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]

notes.title: Update on DLC
notes.content:
Hey Anglers,

We have an announcement to make, and yes, it's about a delay – but please hear us out.

A few months ago, we were thrilled to share with you our release plans for the first DLC for DREDGE, ‘The Iron Rig.’ Originally, we planned to spend a few months crafting this exciting addition and release it in Q4 this year. However, as we progressed, we were faced with the reality that, given the time of the year, we'd need more lead time to coordinate our marketing and make the launch as exciting as it could be.

We were genuinely disheartened because we knew had made a commitment to all our dedicated players, but we firmly believed there was only one path forward and that was to delay ‘The Iron Rig’ until next year while still delivering an exciting DLC to our players in 2023.

So, we've been hard at work crafting some additional content and we can't wait to share more details with you soon, including when it will be available and how much it will cost. We understand that this isn't what we had originally promised but we hope you understand. Your support means the world to us.

Thank you for being an essential part of the DREDGE community and please stay tuned for more info soon!

All the best from the team at Black Salt Games.

notes.title: DREDGE 2023 Roadmap
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing the DREDGE roadmap[/h1]

[b]Throughout 2023 you can expect several free updates, along with some paid DLC:[/b]

[list]
[*] New game modes

[*] Photo mode

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40894993/51882158e654308b61af25c8aa75fbee92b2fb5b.jpg[/img]

[b]Want to know more? Well, our very own Nadia Thorne recently sat down with PlayStation, to discuss what's next for our sinister fishing adventure. Check out what was discussed below:[/b]


[h3]Map Changes[/h3]
"One of the features requested by so many of you is extended functionality for the in-game map, and we’re excited to introduce this with our first free update in May. The addition of map markers will allow you to select from different coloured icons representing everything from dangers, shipwrecks, mysteries, and more, enabling more effective navigation between locations than before. Additionally, this update will include some fixes and balance changes."


[h3]New Game Modes[/h3]
"In our second update, two new modes will introduce very different ways to experience Dredge. The first is Passive Mode, which caters to players who prefer a less intense experience. Monsters that usually attack fishing boats will no longer be aggressive, allowing players to focus on fishing and enjoying the serene surroundings.


This update’s second mode is another much requested feature: Photo mode. But rather than just add the ability with a simple menu option, we’re taking a different approach. When it launches, our photo mode will see the addition of a new in-game character who’ll help players unlock their camera ability and share clues on where to find some of the local marine wildlife as subjects for your photography, some of which will be brand new in this update."


[h3]Boat Customisation[/h3]
"Our third free update will introduce boat customisations such as paint schemes and flags. As you explore the coastlines and bayous of Dredge, you’ll unlock new boat paint schemes and flags to make your fishing vessel really stand out. We’ll have more information on both updates two and three later in the year."


[h3]Ironhaven DLC[/h3]
"Finally, we will be developing a paid and entirely optional DLC featuring the mysterious Ironhaven Corporation. They’re looking to establish an innovative drilling operation in the area to revitalize the towns and populations, but their ultimate goal is unknown. As you gather materials to construct new buildings and biomatter to fuel the rig, meet new characters, craft new equipment, and catch new fish, you may uncover the truth behind their potentially nefarious operations."


[h1]We can't wait to share more with you over the coming weeks and months.[/h1]

notes.title: DREDGE Demo Update: v0.9.1
notes.content:
In this update to the demo for DREDGE we've been able to respond to some of the suggestions you've sent via discord, twitter, or the in-game feedback form. Before we dive into the full patch notes, we want to take a minute to give a little report on what your feedback looks like.

So far, we've processed and sorted over [b]700[/b] individual tickets reported through the in-game feedback form - and there are hundreds more we've yet to go through!

Most Requested Features:
[olist]
[*] Additional Map Functionality
[*] Ability to organize fish in your cargo when you have one on the hook
[*] Control Updates
[*] Tutorials / Communication of features (e.g. Dredging, Panic)
[/olist]
Most commented on design features:
[olist]
[*] Passage of Time
[*] Economy / Debt
[/olist]
Most requested language support:
[olist]
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Polish
[/olist]
Most reported bugs:
[olist]
[*] Dockworker has 2 lines of unlocalized dialogue
[*] Spyglass opening at odd angles
[*] Getting beached on the islands of The Marrows
[*] Crab pots interfering with docking
[*] Missing Turkish uppercase 'i' in font
[/olist]
With that in mind, let's take a look at one of your most suggested features that we've added in this update: the Temporary Storage Tray!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40894993/4214b420993f5792a87c0687d33c3c7dbee4b2ca.gif[/img]

This unlocks after you complete the introduction quest, and allows you to store fish (and trinkets and materials) temporarily so that you can re-arrange your cargo. Any items left in the tray when you exit fishing mode will be lost!

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added temporary storage tray. 
[*] Added controller rumble.
[*] Various performance improvements.
[*] Various SFX and music balancing changes.
[*] Literally hundreds of text fixes and adjustments across all languages.
[*] Adjusted the dredging minigame to better communicate that the notches should be avoided.
[*] The dredging and fishing minigame animations now respect your color preferences.
[*] Adjusted mouse button glyphs to be slightly clearer.
[*] Adjusted xbox controller d-pad glyphs.
[*] The default binding for "Back" is now X. If you have played the game before, your binding won't be adjusted unless you reset it (or reset all settings).
[*] Added more colors into the accessibility dropdowns.
[*] The title logo of the game now changes in Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
[*] The T17 splash screen audio now respects volume preferences.
[*] The T17 splash screen video has changed to a custom DREDGE logo.
[*] Potentially fixed a crash that was preventing the game from running on Windows 7.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Trader's pipe wasn't smoking correctly.
[*] Fixed some geometry where players were getting stuck on the shoreline.
[*] Fixed an issue where Crab pots sometimes would not open or behave correctly for players using the Russian language.
[*] Fixed an issue where the spyglass would remember its previous vertical position when re-activating it.
[*] Fixed an issue where capital i's would appear as squares for players with a Turkish system locale.
[*] Fixed a number of text-wrapping issues on the map for some languages.
[*] Fixed an issue where text line breaks were in bad places in Korean.
[*] Fixed a number of issues that could arise if the player was interrupted while docking (for example, if docking 'through' a placed crab pot).
[/olist]

[h2]Known Issues:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] When rebinding a control on Mouse & Keyboard, the screen says "Press X to cancel binding", but you actually have to press ESCAPE.
[*] Some item descriptions and backgrounds do not follow your color preferences.
[*] The spyglass sometimes opens to strange orientations.
[*] One of the Mayor's dialogue lines about the old fisherman is messed up, in german.
[/olist]

Also, since we last spoke, we've pinned a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1562430/discussions/0/3365901931433213170/]FAQ[/url] topic to our Steam forums.

As always, don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/cGJZAWxZP3?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=nextfest&utm_id=demo]Discord[/url] community and share your feedback.
To keep up to date [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1562430/Dredge/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=nextfest&utm_id=demo]Wishlist[/url] DREDGE, like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/Dredge.Game]Facebook[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/BSG_DREDGE]Twitter[/url].

Thanks for playing <3

notes.title: Demo Update: Build 1516
notes.content:
Hey Anglers,

We have to start by saying THANK YOU to everyone who has played [b]DREDGE: CHAPTER ONE[/b] so far. We've had literally thousands of you play our little fishing game, which has blown our expectations out of the water.

We've just pushed a new build of the demo live with some bugfixes and improvements. All of these came from the feedback you've given us, either via our [url=https://discord.gg/cGJZAWxZP3?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=nextfest&utm_id=demo]Discord[/url] or the in-game feedback form [F10] - so keep that feedback coming!

Here are the patch notes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed a critical issue where players managed to uninstall their engine while out at sea.
[*] Fixed an issue where the tooltip could disappear when installing equipment, making players think they were stuck.
[*] Fixed an exploit where a puzzle reward could be claimed repeatedly.
[*] Fixed an issue where particles on character portraits (flies, dust, etc) scaled incorrectly at high resolutions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the boat's light could be in an incorrect state when loading the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera could get confused when docking near a crab pot.
[*] Fixed a typo in one of the Mayor's lines that we must have not noticed for literally a year.
[*] Fixed a couple of slightly embarrassing chinese translations. [i]Please note that all of our translations are currently being improved for the full release.[/i]
[*] Added a "Reset All Settings" button on the settings screen. [i]Please note that the confirmation dialogue has not been translated into other languages yet.[/i]
[*] If players get lost and dock at Little Marrow before completing the tutorial quest, the Dockworker will pop up and remind them where Greater Marrow is. [i]Please note that this line has not been translated into other languages yet.[/i]
[*] The encyclopedia 'page turn' animation was too severe, so it has been adjusted.
[*] The default master volume of the game is now ~25% quieter. Existing players will be unaffected by this change until they adjust it in the Settings menu.
[*] Adjusted the lighthouse ambience to be much less grating on the ears.
[*] Adjusted some camera colliders around Blackstone Isle.
[*] Add SFX to a previously silent group of sea creatures.
[*] Re-planted some floating trees at the top of some islands.
[/olist]
And some significant known issues:
[olist]
[*] There’s an issue where sometimes you need to disable steam’s PlayStation / Switch support for the game to correctly register these controllers. To solve this: 
Close the game > right click the game in your library > Properties > Controller > Override for DREDGE > Disable Steam Input > Reopen the game
Alternatively, go into your main Steam Settings and disable PlayStation controller support under the controller settings. [i]Please note that this will affect all of your Steam games[/i].
[*] Crab pots may stop working even though they have a few hours of durability left, but only [i]when playing in russian language[/i]. Yeah, don't ask.
[*] The game fails to launch on Windows 7.
[*] Some game UI does not scale nicely on 4:3 aspect ratios.
[/olist]
Q: How do I know if I've received the update?
A: It should say "1516" in the bottom right corner of the title screen.

Don't forget to join our  [url=https://discord.gg/cGJZAWxZP3?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=nextfest&utm_id=demo]Discord[/url] community and share your feedback.

notes.title: DREDGE x Team17
notes.content:
[h1]Explore a mysterious archipelago and fish the unfathomable next year on Steam![/h1]
 
Team17 and New Zealand-based developer Black Salt Games have today announced a publishing partnership to bring DREDGE, an upcoming single-player fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent, to Steam and consoles in 2023. 

In DREDGE, players will step into the boots of a down-on-their luck fisherman and explore a collection of remote isles while scouring the surrounding depths for a variety of fish and valuable deep-sea curios. Once their trawler is full, they can sell their haul to the peculiar locals while completing quests and unravelling more about each archipelago. They can also reinforce their vessel, skills, and knowledge to dredge deeper and reach more secluded lands.   
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40894993/9d559fdb329505b9d09adeba3a5e4e8f18b9c299.png[/img]

Beginning in their new home in the remote islands of ‘The Marrows’, players will be able to investigate each area while completing tasks for the yesteryear locals and taking trips to neighbouring regions - each with their own unique fish to find, inhabitants to meet, and secrets to uncover.  

 
Apprentice anglers and associate ichthyologists can enjoy a brand-new announcement trailer below:  

  
[previewyoutube=kfniX3fH1l0;full][/previewyoutube]

[*] 
[*] [b]Fight the Unfathomable[/b]: Strengthen your mind and use special abilities to survive trips out on the water after dark 
[/list]
